newsitem.title: USA: US spot jet prices rally as diffs, NYMEX firm.
newsitem.headline: US spot jet prices rally as diffs, NYMEX firm.

text.p: U.S. spot jet fuel prices jumped higher Monday as strengthening differentials added the gains seen on the NYMEX.
New York Harbor prompt 54-grade barrels were bid at about 3.00 cents over the screen, with offers as high as 3.50 cents over, traders said, up 0.75 cent from Friday.
U.S. Gulf 54-grade barrels for prompt delivery were offered at about 0.75 cents under the screen, up 0.25 cent on the day.
Despite the gains, traders said market activity remained fairly thin with few sellers emerging.
-- Matt Daily, New York Energy Desk +1 212 859 1626
